# Typing states taken from the Aeneas sources: each line is a case name, a
# file under vendor/virgil/aeneas/src, how much of the text after the cursor
# to delete (line: the rest of its line; file: the rest of the file), and a
# needle whose first occurrence in the file locates the cursor at its "|".
# scripts/repair-corpus.py analyzes each with the whole Aeneas program.

aeneas-call-second-argument	vst/Parser.v3	line	var file = VstFile.new(fileName, |input);

aeneas-call-nested	vst/Verifier.v3	line	paramTypes = Lists.reverse(|paramTypes);
